canonical_project: Paltel Group Al-Bireh Tier III Data Center (second Paltel data center)
notes: DCD reported Paltel Group launched its second data center, a 65,000 sq ft (~6,000 sq m) facility in Ramallah/Al-Bireh, central West Bank, Uptime Tier III Design certified (first in the country to receive an Uptime award), built at ~$10m for colocation, cloud-based disaster recovery and back-office services; opened at a ceremony with PM Mohammad Shtayyeh in late September 2019.
